evals.expected_output: Extracts page/frame list, entry, main flow, state coverage, fields, design-system basis, interaction red lines from PRD's '原型约束契约'; covers each; does not invent un-authorized pages
assertions: Output extracts and consumes every item of the PRD's '原型约束契约' (page list, entry, main flow, state coverage, fields, design-system basis, red lines).
Output does NOT add pages, entries, main flows, or business branches not authorized by the PRD.
Output records coverage and gaps of the constraint contract in the Prototype tab.

evals.prompt: $product:prototype 给订单审核页面做 HTML 原型
evals.expected_output: prototype.html is a standalone interactive prototype: clickable main flow, >=2 real controls, >=3 switchable states driven by JS; first screen is a product surface not a description page; NO large PRD background / user stories / AC matrix / test cases
assertions: prototype.html first screen is an operable product surface, not a requirement description or onboarding page.
prototype.html contains at least 2 real interactive controls (form input, filter, toggle, modal, etc.) and at least 3 switchable states (default/empty/loading/error/success/permission).
prototype.html does NOT contain large PRD background, user stories, acceptance-criteria matrix, requirement lists, or test cases.
States are driven by JavaScript (or equivalent), not just static layout partitions.

evals.expected_output: Reads workflow_policy.prototype_route; if route is stitch but user invoked HTML route, requests explicit override and records explicit_override + reason + risk; does not silently produce HTML
assertions: Output reads workflow_policy.prototype_route from .product-workflow-config.json.
If route is stitch but HTML route was invoked, output requests explicit user override before proceeding.
If proceeding under override, output records explicit_override, reason, and risk in the artifact.

evals.expected_output: Prototype tab is projected from prototype.html and embeds main review content (main flow, representative panels, states, domain data, reuse basis, review decision points); not only a link to prototype.html
assertions: The Prototype tab embeds main review content (main flow, representative panels, key states, reuse basis, review decision points).
The Prototype tab is NOT just a link to prototype.html or a short summary / screenshot placeholder.
If an independent prototype.html exists, it only serves as supplementary full-screen preview with a back-link to the board Prototype tab.

evals.prompt: $product:prototype 这是一个纯 CLI 命令行功能，没有界面
evals.expected_output: Non-UI requirement still produces an interactive prototype: flow simulator, state machine sandbox, CLI/API interactive console, or permission/config switcher; only 'prototype not applicable' when user explicitly confirms
assertions: Output produces an interactive prototype for the non-UI requirement (flow simulator, state-machine sandbox, CLI/API console, or equivalent).

The interactive prototype covers main flow, state transitions, and real domain data relevant to the CLI function.

evals.prompt: $product:prototype。目标是现有 Vue 订单列表的批量下载按钮，请沿用当前组件和设计。

assertions: Detects Vue from package.json or .vue files and reads stacks/vue.md.

assertions: Runs prepare_prototype.mjs instead of hand-editing mechanical assets.
